title: Code review: find the bugs
units/0/blurb: A mutable struct and its copies, a singleton with side effects, an unclosed FileStream, HttpClient with .Result, Dictionary<object,…>, an empty catch and a God class — everything hiding in a “simple” model manager.
units/1/blurb: A closure in a loop, async void, dictionary keys, collections, recursion, exceptions and Unity’s “fake null” — a dozen bugs in one clash-detection service.
units/2/blurb: Blocking inside async, a deadlock on Unity’s main thread, races and GetOrAdd, a timer the GC collects, and a tidy-looking cancellation that cancels nothing.
units/3/blurb: Allocations in Update, leaked materials and broken batching, OnEnable without OnDisable, HasFlag, a comparator that throws, and a cache that is LRU in name only.
